title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Acceptance Status at Which a Late Declaration Is Charged
content:
## Clause

A late declaration under Dangerous Goods Acceptance is charged when the line has taken it for the sailing, and the acceptance record makes that visible by showing the review as started. The late declaration fee is accordingly booked on an acceptance that is under review.

Two facts explain this status. Where the signature came after the late-acceptance deadline, the declaration is not taken, and the acceptance it belongs to stays submitted, so a submitted acceptance does not show a declaration that was taken. And a late declaration fee may be entered only on an acceptance that is submitted or under review; an acceptance that has been decided can no longer be charged with it.

## Status grid

| Acceptance status | Late declaration fee chargeable |
|---|---|
| under review | yes, when the declaration judged is late |
| submitted | no |
| approved, rejected, withdrawn, loaded, discharged or closed | no |

## Point of judgement

**The file was approved last week and the late signature has only now been noticed.** A decided acceptance is beyond the reach of the late declaration fee.
